whatIs.heading: What is Spektt?
whatIs.body: Spektt is where creatives — photographers, videographers, 3D animators, digital artists, sound engineers and more — find their community, meet brands and get hired. Share your work, join communities (Clusters) built around your craft, and get found by verified brands looking for creatives like you.

items.desc: Join communities built around your craft, your style or your city — each with its own feed, members and moderators.
Verified brands find creators on Spektt. Switch on Open to work and they can send you inquiries about paid work.
Share photos and videos with a global audience. Pin your best with Spotlights and curate Collections.
Connect and collaborate with other creatives directly.
Put your work up for the community to vote on and judges to score — with cash prizes in some.
Unlimited Spotlights and Collections, a Pro badge and an XP boost.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.body: 100% fan-voted. The community decides the winner — no judges, no panels. The entry with the most votes wins.

premium.name: Premium
premium.body: Two-stage judging. Fans vote to pick the top 20, then expert judges score the finalists. Fan votes count for 60%, judge scores count for 40%.

about.heading: What is
about.p1: Are you ready to take your creative journey to the next level? Spektt is the platform built for creatives — photographers, videographers, 3D animators, digital artists, sound engineers, and more — to showcase their work, find their community, meet brands and get hired.
about.p2: We built Spektt because we know firsthand the challenges that come with being a creative in today's fast-paced digital world. Getting your work seen is hard. Finding your community is harder. That's why we created a platform that puts your creativity at the centre — with the tools, the audience, and the opportunities to match.
about.p3: Spektt is built around community. Clusters bring creatives together around a craft, a style or a city. Verified brands come to Spektt to find creators, and anyone who switches on Open to work can be reached for paid work. And Showdowns — where the community votes and judges weigh in — are one more way to get noticed.
about.p4: Beyond that, Spektt gives you a feed to share your work, Clusters to find your niche community, Showdowns and a leaderboard to see where you stand, and a milestone system that rewards every step of your creative journey. The more you create, the more you grow.
about.p5: At Spektt, we believe geography should never be a barrier to recognition. We're building a platform where any creative, anywhere in the world, can access the same opportunities, the same stage, and the same chance to be seen.
about.p6: Spektt is more than a platform — it's a community. Whether you're just starting out or already established, you'll find your people here. Join a community, build your profile, and let your work speak for itself.

featured.title: How Spektt features creators
featured.intro: Spektt writes short articles about creatives on the platform: how they work, what they made, what they learned. You'll find them in the Articles section of the Explore tab. This page explains who gets featured, why, and what you can expect.
featured.whyIntro: Every article about a creator says why at the top, in one line. There are four reasons, and we only use a reason we can show:

reasons.name: Showdown placement
reasons.text: you placed 1st, 2nd or 3rd in a showdown. We check the official results before publishing.

reasons.name: Milestone
reasons.text: you reached a level on Spektt. We check your level before publishing.

reasons.name: Chosen by the Spektt team
reasons.text: our team picked your work because it stood out. This is how most new creators are featured.

reasons.name: Nominated by members
reasons.text: people on Spektt asked us to write about you.

who: Anyone on Spektt, in any country and any craft: photography, videography, 3D animation, sound engineering, digital art.
You must be 18 or over. We don't feature anyone younger, or show their work or profile in an article.
Your account must be in good standing: not suspended, banned or being deleted.
The work we show must be your own original work.
Brand and company accounts aren't featured in these articles.
featured.notTitle: What keeps someone from being featured
not: Work that is copied, or that isn't yours to share.
Recent breaks of our Community Guidelines, such as warnings or removed content.
Being featured in the last 30 days: we space features out so the spotlight moves around.
featured.consentIntro: We never feature anyone without asking. Before an article about you is published, you agree to:
consent: every image of your work we show,
every quote we use from you.
featured.consentAfter: If anything changes before it goes out, we ask again. Nobody pays to be featured, and Spektt doesn't take payment for these articles: they aren't ads.
featured.disclosure: If the writer knows you personally, the article says so, in a short note above the story.
featured.live: You get a notification in the app: "You're featured in a Spektt article". The article shows your name, a link to your profile and a Follow button. Readers can comment on it, and our usual reporting and blocking tools apply to those comments.
featured.nominate: Know a creator whose work deserves a story? Tell us through the {contact} or at {email}: their @username and a line on why. We read every nomination; we can't write about everyone.
featured.withdraw: You can withdraw at any time. Email {email} from the address on your Spektt account and say which article. As soon as we get it, we take the article down, or remove the parts about you.
